answer.reason: The verses tell of Saul hurling the spear at David and Jonathan and of David taking it from his bolster.

clauses.english: was thrown at David, who slipped away, and stuck in the wall
clauses.quote: Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin

clauses.english: was thrown at Jonathan in Saul's anger
clauses.quote: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him

clauses.english: was taken by David from Saul's bolster while Saul slept
clauses.quote: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's bolster

doubts: The verses say "javelin" in 1SA 18-20 and "spear" in 1SA 22 and 26; I took them as the same weapon, as the summary does.
Left out 1SA 18:11 (an earlier throw at David), 1SA 26:22 (the spear returned) and 2SA 1:6 (Saul leaning on his spear at Gilboa) as lesser or repeated detail.
